text: dsh-quota-dashboard（DSH Web 插件）：统计会话 Token 用量和费用，并集中查看多个模型服务的账户余额与订阅额度。插件监听模型调用 usage 并记入账本，在 Web 界面提供费用显示和设置面板。可按模型计价、设置预算、查看历史、同步 DeepSeek 价格，以及查询 DeepSeek、OpenCode GO、Kimi、GLM 和火山方舟额度。适合需要掌握模型开销和额度的 DSH 用户。

dsh-quota-dashboard tracks DSH session token costs and provider quotas in the Web UI. It records model usage, supports budgets and history, syncs DeepSeek pricing, and queries balances or subscription limits for DeepSeek, OpenCode GO, Kimi, GLM, and Volcengine Ark.
想在 DSH 里按模型查看每次会话用了多少 Token、花了多少钱。
我想在一个面板里看 DeepSeek 和其他模型服务还剩多少额度。
能不能给 DSH 的模型调用做费用统计和预算跟踪？
希望同步官方价格，并查看历史 Token 用量。
Show me session costs and token usage by model in DSH.
I need one dashboard for balances and subscription quotas across AI providers.
dsh-quota-dashboard 的功能「会话费用与 Token 统计」：捕获模型流中的 usage 数据并写入账本，支持按模型汇总输入、输出和缓存 Token。
dsh-quota-dashboard 的功能「多 Provider 额度看板」：并行查询启用的 Provider，并把每项结果整理成独立状态行。
dsh-quota-dashboard 的功能「预算与历史账本」：保存每日及会话聚合费用，并提供历史记录供界面查看。
dsh-quota-dashboard 的功能「官方价格同步」：抓取 DeepSeek 定价页并解析模型价格表，以更新本地价格配置。
dsh-quota-dashboard 使用前须知：额度查询会连接已启用 Provider 的接口，价格同步会读取 DeepSeek 官方定价页；费用账本保存在 DSH_HOME 下。
想把不同 AI 服务的订阅用量和重置时间放在一起查看。
Keep a daily record of model token costs and compare them with a spending budget.

    dsh plugin --profile web add link:/absolute/path/to/dsh-quota-dashboard

# 或发布到 GitHub / npm 后
    dsh plugin --profile web add github:<you>/dsh-quota-dashboard

安装后**重启 dsh web** 生效。设置 → 额度看板 · Quota 查看看板。

dsh-quota-dashboard README · 配置：凭证解析优先序:DSH 凭据库(ctx.credentials)→ 环境变量。OpenCode GO 支持 OPENCODE_API_KEY 旧名与 opencode CLI 登录态；Kimi 支持 KIMI_API_KEY，以及 Kimi Code CLI 登录态（旧版 ~/.kimi/credentials/kimi-code.json、新版 KIMI_CODE_HOME/credentials/*.json，Windows 默认 %USERPROFILE%\.kimi-code）。

dsh-quota-dashboard README · 安全：- 凭证只在宿主进程解析,绝不进入浏览器或日志;余额/额度查询只发往各自官方固定域名
- 看板数据经同源 /quota-dashboard-api/state(loopback Host + 自定义头双重守卫)下发
- 火山方舟 AK/SK 经火山 SigV4 签名,密钥不出现在 URL / 命令行
- 账本与配置仅写 DSH_HOME/storages/quota-dashboard/ledger.json(原子写)
- 本插件与 dsh-cost-meter **互斥**:二者功能重叠(同款账本/服务),请勿同时安装

dsh-quota-dashboard README · Installation：> Requirements: Node.js ≥ 20 + DeepSeek Harness (a version with the `dsh plugin` command; `npm install -g @deepseek-ai/dsh`).

dsh-quota-dashboard README · One-click install (recommended)：**PowerShell one-click script** (copy the whole line, paste, press Enter; pnpm is provisioned automatically, git is auto-detected — no clone needed; the install chain is **pinned to the release tag `v1.3.1`** — review the script before running):

```powershell
irm https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Han-1413141/dsh-cost-meter/v1.3.1/install.ps1 | iex
```

**Or a plain command line** (the machine must already have pnpm and git; also pinned to the tag):

dsh-quota-dashboard README · One-click install (recommended)：```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add github:Han-1413141/dsh-cost-meter#v1.3.1
```

Without git, use the GitHub tag archive:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add https://github.com/Han-1413141/dsh-cost-meter/archive/refs/tags/v1.3.1.tar.gz
```

After installing, **restart** `dsh web` (plugin rows, the Typert manifest and the client bundle are all scanned at startup):

```sh
dsh web
```

dsh-quota-dashboard README · Architecture：The plugin never imports cordis/dsh Service/Context runtime classes (only Node builtins, zod, and pure functions from dsh-home-paths and dsh-credentials), so it shares one runtime instance with the host with no duplicated dependency risk.

dsh-quota-dashboard README · How official price sync works：The parsed result is written into the price table and persisted; if the page structure changes, sync reports an error and keeps the previous prices, with manual editing as a fallback.

dsh-quota-dashboard README · AI price sync：[docs/AI-PRICE-SYNC-PROMPT.en.md](docs/AI-PRICE-SYNC-PROMPT.en.md) (English) and [docs/AI-PRICE-SYNC-PROMPT.md](docs/AI-PRICE-SYNC-PROMPT.md) (中文) provide prompts you can copy straight into any AI:
the AI reads the official pricing on its own → outputs per-model, time-of-day (base/off-peak/peak + effective time) price JSON → you review and apply it (Settings page / RPC / file — pick one). Handy when the official prices change.
